notes.note: Reviewed the affected claims against pre-push pure-merge classification, merge-base ratchet attribution and gate-for reporting. Pure classification uses remote ls-remote main, verified local commits, ancestry, at most20 first-parent two-parent merges and exact conflict-free automatic merge trees, with replace objects/grafts disabled. Unknown/new/tag/edited/conflicted/non-main/network-failure cases run full hooks. Existing real-Git/hook controls passed;31 tests across report/classifier and ratchet process suites PASS. The report omitted the new classifier (baseline9PASS1FAIL); it now names it and describes a normal source-edit push with actual-ref classification deciding lighter execution. Removing the report entry reproduced specific parityRED9PASS1FAIL; exact restored10PASS. Classifier capture now uses bounded repository helper while preserving timeout/refusal behavior. Fixture/type-laundering baselines compare merge base, with current-tip fallback only when unresolved; real-gate entry-removal and entry-addition controls retain enforcement. RequiredCI/queue checks remain; the lighter path assumes remote tip was previously gated and does not measure a combination-only transfer regression before a later non-pure push. Those disclosed limits are not presented as runtime certification. No protected standards/CI check, baseline entry, permission or source threshold was relaxed. Review covers this tooling delta; unrelated document claims and native/provider/canonical completion remain outside proof. Current fullCI/normal source-edit hooks/hosted exact-head acceptance still required.
